description: PDF page box check: trim, bleed and safe area from supplied boxes — Checks the five PDF page boxes you supply (MediaBox, CropBox, BleedBox, TrimBox, ArtBox, in points) for a print job: applies the ISO 32000-1 defaults and media-box clipping, measures bleed on each side of the trim box, and tests the content box against a safe margin inside the trim, for agents that prepare or accept print-ready PDFs. It does not read a PDF file, check fonts, colour, image resoluti

contentBox.description: Bounding box of the live content, same coordinates as the page boxes. If absent the ArtBox (when supplied) is used.

pageBoxes.description: mediaBox is required; the others are optional and default per ISO 32000-1 (cropBox to mediaBox; bleedBox, trimBox, artBox to cropBox).

artBox.description: [x1 y1 x2 y2] in default user space units; any two diagonal corners.

bleedBox.description: [x1 y1 x2 y2] in default user space units; any two diagonal corners.

cropBox.description: [x1 y1 x2 y2] in default user space units; any two diagonal corners.

mediaBox.description: [x1 y1 x2 y2] in default user space units; any two diagonal corners.

trimBox.description: [x1 y1 x2 y2] in default user space units; any two diagonal corners.

minBleed.description: Smallest allowed distance from trim to bleed box on every side.

safeMargin.description: Smallest allowed distance from trim to live content on every side.

tolerancePt.description: Slack in points before a shortfall counts (default 0.01) so 3 mm written as 8.5 pt is not a failure.

unit.description: Unit of minBleed and safeMargin; default mm. pt means points (1/72 inch) of user space after UserUnit.

userUnit.description: The page's UserUnit (default 1): the size of one user space unit in 1/72 inch.

name: print-box
